    """
    Test that iterators are handled by is_iterator instead of ensure_has_len.
    
    This test specifically checks the behavior change in the reindex method
    where target = ensure_has_len(target) was changed to 
    if is_iterator(target): target = list(target)
    """
    # This test ensures that iterator handling works correctly

    iterator = iter(["a", "b", "c"])
    result = list(iterator)

    Old algorithm: trim one space at a time in a loop
    New algorithm: calculate minimum leading spaces and trim all at once
    """
